design: Retrospective 240-point stream; detrended half-stream autocorrelation change >.22 OR residual RMS ratio >1.5 marks a shift. If flagged, fit HAC lag3 drift on last 120 samples (12 bins of ten) and apply shift-flagged split-calibrated 90th-percentile standardized-error multiplier. Otherwise fit whole240 with its pooled calibration multiplier. No hidden scenario labels in policy.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot observed before freeze; no post-pilot retuning. Two fewer false confirmations, ten fewer correct decisions, twelve extra abstentions.

limitations: Full-window retrospective feature, not an online predecision guard
37 calibration shifted streams gives uncertain group quantile
Possible synthetic nonstationarity and nonexchangeability mean no finite-sample conditional guarantee
True slope used in calibration only; policy never sees it
